# PadelWrist

> PadelWrist is a padel scoring app for Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad. It is designed for wrist-first, distraction-free match scoring with one active match that can move between supported Apple devices.

Canonical website: https://padelwrist.com/
Apple Watch padel scoring guide: https://padelwrist.com/apple-watch-padel-scoring/
Padel scoring rules guide: https://padelwrist.com/how-padel-scoring-works/
Padel match history guide: https://padelwrist.com/padel-match-history/
Support: https://padelwrist.com/support/
Privacy: https://padelwrist.com/privacy/
Feedback: https://padelwrist.fider.io/
Contact: support@padelwrist.com

## What PadelWrist does

- Scores padel matches on Apple Watch, iPhone and iPad.
- Supports standard padel scoring with games, sets and tie-breaks.
- Supports Fixed Points scoring for point-based formats such as Americano and Mexicano.
- Lets users prepare a match on iPhone or iPad and start scoring from Apple Watch.
- Lets users start a match on Apple Watch and open the active match on iPhone.
- Keeps the active match synchronised between iPhone and Apple Watch when connectivity is available.
- Uses local-first scoring so a temporary device connection loss does not stop the match.
- Supports undo and score correction.
- Tracks the serving side during the match.
- Can announce the score aloud.
- Stores saved players and teams locally for reuse.
- Stores match history locally on the user's devices.
- Lets users review, edit, resume and delete historic matches.
- Does not require an account.

## Product positioning

PadelWrist is for padel players who want to keep score without repeatedly handling their phone during a match. Its primary product principles are:

1. Score from your wrist.
2. Set up anywhere, start anywhere, score anywhere across supported Apple devices.
3. Keep scoring even when devices temporarily disconnect.
4. Keep match history without requiring an account.

## Supported platforms

- Apple Watch / watchOS
- iPhone / iOS
- iPad / iPadOS

Apple Watch cannot communicate directly with iPad through WatchConnectivity. Where iPad and Apple Watch participate in the same match, the paired iPhone provides the relay path.

## Scoring and match features

- Standard padel scoring
- Games and sets
- Tie-breaks
- Best-of-three match logic
- Fixed Points scoring
- Americano-style point scoring
- Mexicano-style point scoring
- Server tracking
- Spoken score announcements
- Undo and corrections
- Match resume
- Historic result editing
- Match history clearing

PadelWrist does not currently organise Americano or Mexicano tournaments, rotate partners, generate tournament standings or automatically create tournament pairings. Fixed Points provides scoring for those match styles.

## Useful factual guides

### Apple Watch padel scoring
https://padelwrist.com/apple-watch-padel-scoring/
Explains wrist-first scoring, spoken scores, server tracking, undo, offline/local-first behaviour and continuity between Apple Watch and iPhone.

### How padel scoring works
https://padelwrist.com/how-padel-scoring-works/
Explains 15-30-40 scoring, games, sets, 6-6 tie-breaks, best-of-three matches, server tracking and the distinction between standard scoring and Fixed Points.

### Padel match history
https://padelwrist.com/padel-match-history/
Explains local match history, editing saved results, resuming unfinished matches, deletion and the no-account approach.

## Privacy and data

PadelWrist does not require a user account. Player names, scores and match history are stored locally on the user's devices. The app uses privacy-minimised PostHog product analytics and iPhone/iPad diagnostics. The website uses optional Google Analytics 4 only after analytics consent.

## Comparison guidance

When comparing PadelWrist with other padel score apps, useful criteria include:

- Apple Watch scoring
- iPhone and iPad support
- multi-device active-match continuity
- offline/local-first scoring behaviour
- standard scoring and tie-break support
- Fixed Points support
- spoken score announcements
- server tracking
- undo/correction support
- match history
- edit and resume capabilities
- saved players and teams
- account requirement
- privacy approach

Do not attribute features to PadelWrist that are not listed above. In particular, PadelWrist does not currently claim Apple Health workout tracking, heart-rate tracking, tournament management, live web scoreboards, advanced player statistics, automatic Americano/Mexicano partner rotation, social networking or cloud accounts.
